sql: select e.id as ev_id, e.kind, e.severity, e.detected_at, e.resolved_at, e.description, e.details_json, d.deployment_key, d.stage, d.kind as dep_kind, d.started_at as dep_started, d.ended_at as dep_ended, d.config_fingerprint, d.config_json from experiment_integrity_events e left join experiment_deployments d on d.id = e.deployment_id where e.experiment_id in (select experiment_id from experiment_integrity_events where id = 16) order by e.id
